302.description: Redirect to the OIDC provider, or to the login page with an `oidc_error` code

description:
Redirects the browser to the OIDC provider with a new state, nonce and PKCE challenge. When OIDC is not active or the provider is not reachable, it redirects to the login page with `oidc_error` instead. 10 requests per address in 5 minutes.

Needs: nothing (public)
